title: AASStackStateManifest
description: State tracking manifest schema for autonomous multi-step agent workflows (aas-stack.json).

stack_name.description: Identifier of the active workflow or stack (e.g. feature-development, bug-fix, saas-launch).

current_phase.description: Name of the active workflow phase (e.g. planning, tdd, review, deploy).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last state modification.

state_variables.description: Arbitrary key-value store for session variables (e.g. baseline_commit, modified_files, port, framework).

skill_used.description: Skill ID invoked for this step.

plan_progress.description: Checklist tracking step-by-step progress through the workflow.

rationale.description: Why this decision was chosen over alternatives.

decisions_log.description: Lightweight architectural decision records (ADRs) logged during the session.
